_doc: Manifest for the enclosure layer — the fence lines, yards and pens the town was full of and this project had no way to build. A static host cannot be globbed, which is why this file exists: the renderer fetches this manifest and then exactly the files it names, never a probe. An enclosure is NOT a structure record: it takes a perimeter rather than a footprint, it is roofless, and it carries no GLB, so it is drawn by renderers/web/js/enclosures.js from these numbers alone and needs no bake. docs/LIBERTIES.md L10 and L60 both name the missing enclosure archetype as what they are waiting for; this layer is the renderer-side half of it.
coordinates: Local East-North-Up metres from data/datum.json's origin — the same frame data/streets/1835.json writes its street centrelines in, and the frame the sidecars' placement.local_e / local_n use.
